entries.0807a1c12a44dd15: Corporations that use advertising products and the like
entries.0b55be6425a1868e: Ads not included in the three types above, along with paid digital content and services. Advertising includes "LINE Byte" (LINE Ads); content and services include "LINE Stickers", "LINE GAME", "LINE Fortune-Telling", "LINE MUSIC", "LINE Manga", "LINE Search", "LYP Premium", "ebookjapan", "Yahoo! Mail", and real estate-related items, among others. External revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥150,349 million (prior year: ¥150,855 million). This "Other" is a category within the Media Business, distinct from the "Other" that is not included in reportable segments.
entries.2068059c87625fda: These are ads delivered through "LINE Official Account", as well as ads such as "LINE Promotional Stickers", "Apply with LINE" and "LINE Flyers". External revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥145,707 million (prior year: ¥126,351 million); against a backdrop of growth in the number of paid "LINE Official Account" accounts and expanded pay-per-use billing, it continued to grow strongly, up 15.3% year on year.
entries.2dc5fb2adb62806d: The business mainly provides payment and financial services. Centered on the cashless payment service "PayPay", it includes the credit card business PayPay Card, the bank PayPay Bank, PayPay Securities, and LINE Bank Taiwan, an internet-only bank in Taiwan. External revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥442,277 million, making it the third-largest of the three reportable segments. Revenue including inter-segment revenue was ¥445.7 billion, up 30.6% year on year, reflecting growth in the PayPay consolidated business and the consolidation of LINE Bank Taiwan Limited as a subsidiary in June 2025. Consolidated payment volume, calculated by combining the payment volumes of PayPay Corporation, PayPay Card Corporation and PayPay Bank Corporation and eliminating internal transactions, was ¥19.4 trillion, up 23.4% year on year.
entries.4da227375f2edfc7: A company that operates "LINE" and "Yahoo! JAPAN" and handles advertising, online shopping, and payments and finance such as PayPay.
entries.6495f893312a1f73: These are the payment, card, banking and securities services provided by PayPay Corporation and its consolidated subsidiaries. The business includes PayPay, PayPay Card, Credit Engine, PayPay Bank and PayPay Securities; PayPay Corporation made PayPay Bank Corporation and PayPay Securities Corporation consolidated subsidiaries in April 2025. Amounts for the PayPay consolidated business are not shown separately within the Strategic Business.
entries.732693cd4dff01eb: The business plans and operates services for planning, selling and placing advertising products, provides information placement services, and provides other services for corporate customers. Advertising products such as "Yahoo! Ads" and "LINE Official Account" are central, and the business also includes paid digital content such as "LINE Stickers" and "LINE Manga". External revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥729,339 million, making it the second-largest of the three reportable segments. Revenue including inter-segment revenue was ¥735.1 billion, up 0.4% year on year.
entries.952d67309d61558f: This business mainly sells products and plans and provides services over the internet, targeting small and medium-sized enterprises and individuals. In addition to the shopping business, such as 'Yahoo! Shopping', the reuse business, such as 'Yahoo! Auctions' and 'Yahoo! Flea Market', and the service EC business, such as 'Yahoo! Travel' and 'ikyu.com', it includes ZOZO, Inc., which operates the fashion mail-order site 'ZOZOTOWN', and ASKUL Corporation, which sells office-related products and the like. In the fiscal year ended March 2026, external revenue (revenue from outside the group) was ¥854,892 million, making it the largest of the three reportable segments. Revenue including intersegment revenue was ¥857.6 billion (up 1.1% year on year), increasing due to the consolidation of BEENOS Inc. and LINE MAN CORPORATION PTE. LTD. as consolidated subsidiaries and higher revenue in the ZOZO Group shopping business, although a ransomware attack caused a system failure at ASKUL Corporation in October 2025 that had an impact. E-commerce transaction value (the sum of the transaction value of each commerce business service and of paid digital content and other items in the media business) was ¥4.6729 trillion (up 7.1% year on year), of which domestic product sales-related transaction value was ¥3.3161 trillion (up 6.3%).
entries.9dc90a6c59e217f6: Ads displayed as images and the like, divided into two types by placement method: programmatic and reserved. Programmatic ads include Yahoo! Ads "Display Ads" (programmatic), "LINE VOOM", "LINE NEWS", "Talk List" and "Talk Head View Custom"; reserved ads include Yahoo! Ads "Display Ads" (reserved), "Talk Head View" and others. External revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥254,244 million (prior year: ¥247,870 million), with both programmatic and reserved ads increasing year on year.
entries.a703c689e9d977b7: This is the part of the Commerce Business whose segment name is "LY Corporation", and it consists of the Shopping Business, the Reuse Business, the Service EC Business and others. The Shopping Business comprises "Yahoo! Shopping", "LINE Brand Catalog", "LINE FRIENDS", "LINE Gift" and overseas EC (such as "LINE SHOPPING" in Taiwan and Thailand); the Reuse Business comprises "Yahoo! Auctions", "Yahoo! Flea Market" and BEENOS Inc.; and the Service EC Business comprises "Yahoo! Travel", "Ikyu.com", "LINE Travel (Taiwan)" and "LINE MAN". External revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥229,828 million, compared with ¥161,801 million in the prior year (the prior-year figure is the restated amount reflecting transfers associated with an organizational restructuring).
entries.d831d807dfbd2d54: These are financial services not included in the PayPay consolidated business. It includes "PayPay Insurance", LINE Bank Taiwan in Taiwan, "LINE Score", "LINE Pocket Money", "LINE FX" and others. Additionally, the Japanese "LINE Pay" service ended on April 30, 2025. Amounts for this category are not shown separately within the Strategic Business.
